about.title: Full Stack Developer
about.lead:
I am a software developer focused on web applications and REST APIs, with experience in documentation, system integration, and building solutions for modern environments.

At IXC Soft, I started in Technical Support and gradually transitioned into development-focused activities, gaining hands-on experience with Node.js, React.js, MongoDB, and API tools such as Postman. I have an analytical mindset, strong adaptability to new technologies, and a continuous interest in building solutions that improve processes and product delivery.
about.para: I am looking for opportunities where I can continue growing technically, contribute to challenging projects, and further develop my career in software engineering.
